content: We need to determine SMILES of unknown compound given only "provided organic compound sample in a lab environment". No data given. We need to use tools to get spectra etc. But we have no initial data. Perhaps the environment has a sample at hand; we can call mass_spectrometry_spectra to get mass, then maybe NMR etc. We need to minimize cost. Start with mass spec to get molecular weight and formula. Then maybe get NMR to deduce structure. Let's call mass_spectrometry_spectra.
